g.text: Finite-difference sieve: proposed event inventory
T-1520 | 2026-11-03 | source reading, no new measurements
Status: interpretation proposed for independent review. Historical nine-category prices are
preserved. Integrated native source begins 061f4f9f; exact bindings are in inventory.json.
Symbolic delta: candidate minus original Horner evaluation
Degree
Active reads
Base M delta
Base add delta
Visit delta
-p
All entries are symbolic source-counter identities. The candidate performs two setup additions and
three additions for every x, including the final unused update. The native caller uses degree two;
lower degrees are component controls.
Proposed classification and source sites
Lines 963-968: charge k=2d+1 active coefficient reads once. Inactive array tails are ignored. Local
scalar Copy and zero padding create no collection elements under the proposed baseline-consistent
convention.
Lines 964-967: four get/first optional-access expressions add bounds/Option machinery. Proposed
exclusion: API/control machinery, not extra collection comparisons. This requires explicit
independent policy review; it does not claim those operations are free machine instructions.
Lines 970-979: two initialization additions and 3p recurrence additions enter the existing base_adds
field. Replaced Horner multiplications are non-inverse work. Existing analyzer fields already map
these events; no invented weight or new field is needed.
Existing exceptional predicates, batch inversion and bucket operations retain their selected event
classes. Two categories change: field arithmetic and collection/graph/elimination. Seven historical
categories are unaffected by the recurrence, subject to final integrated route binding.
Required next binding
A non-author reviewer must accept or correct the Option/copy classification and exact primitive
inventory. Rebind final source sites, mapper, protocol and candidate/reference binaries. Preserve
old p739 as old-arm evidence; require fresh candidate results across all 1,260 original targets.
This packet admits no scientific execution or new 36-cell ratios. Allocation, reporting, harness and
infrastructure remain separate resource units under the existing policy. CSV and JSON retain every
classification for review.
